evals.prompt: Enable game-po-async for this planning simulation. Do not launch agents, invoke an orchestration runtime, mutate files, or run the game. Act as main game designer/PO. The user wants a satisfying optional forage detour without making the direct path pointless. Local design notes already explain the risk/reward intent and feedback cues. Gameplay lane G owns its isolated gameplay checkout; art lane A owns another checkout, has no gameplay prerequisite, and is still rendering. Shared integration/save files belong to main. One native async workflow is active, with spare configured capacity but no request for a fixed team. Its gameplay writer g-write-21 has just completed; the report and diff are readable and unit checks pass. Its new penalty may consume the player's saved currency after a missed input. No reviewer has yet inspected it. The artist will take much longer. Later, a fresh reviewer sends native request req-g-8: it recommends removing currency loss, keeping the optional time detour, and retaining feedback cues; the user delegated ordinary gameplay tuning to you. After the fix and review, gameplay has a dependency-ready feedback test that does not require art. Give the concrete event order from this completion through that test, your PO decision/rationale, ownership and routing/discovery checks, and what you do while art runs. Identify actual gates and artifacts. Explain who dispatches each follow-up if the existing workflow is still running. Do not claim any real execution occurred.
evals.expected_output: A branch-local writer/review/native-main-decision/fix/review/test sequence, continuing independently of art, with player-facing rationale and no duplicate top-level workflow or shared writers.
expectations: Schedules fresh read-only review of g-write-21 immediately, then the ready gameplay test after correction/re-review, without waiting for art or a global all-results barrier.
Main rejects or revises saved-currency loss with a concrete choice/risk/reward/economy rationale and uses existing design evidence rather than reflexively commissioning research.
Replies to exact native request req-g-8 through subagent_supervisor reply; steering and reviewer success are not treated as approval.
Keeps the active top-level workflow as the dispatch owner and describes branch follow-ups inside it, observing all child promises instead of launching another workflow.
Selects useful roles elastically after agent/model discovery, explicitly preserves openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol:high routing and configured ceilings, and does not allocate a fixed number of specialists.
Keeps gameplay/art writers isolated, shared integration/save files with main, and review read-only with native inline output binding; consumes actual diff/checks and durable output mappings.
Uses native completion notifications and yields only when no safe immediate action remains, without sleep/status polling/bg_wait for ordinary children.

expectations: Records the exact provider error, runtime failure kind, s-run-44, cwd/ref/VCS, and verifies process/ownership plus clean state or captures partial diff before any audio retry.

evals.prompt: Enable game-po-async's occasional observer for this non-executing plan exercise. Do not launch agents/tools, mutate files/settings, run a timer/CLI, or change game canon. User clarified that the observer must see MAIN and the whole team; max-one limits observer instances, not observed workers. Goal: improve optional forage feedback without stalling game delivery. Approved constraints reserve asset concepts to the user, keep one writer per workspace, main owns shared integration, and each runtime follows its own current model/effort policy. The existing parent board has main awaiting a completed gameplay review before integration, gameplay G complete with fresh checks, art A independently running behind a user concept gate, audio S blocked on provider recovery, and documentation D ready in its own workspace. A recent 3-minute event summary also shows main dispatched a second scout for G despite already having fresh scout evidence. Describe the compact observation packet and give decisions for these separate opportunities: a random miss with otherwise eligible state; an active observer lease; an unknown prior lease after a new session; only the last production slot free; a random hit after 35 minutes with a reconciled free lease, spare capacity, usable records, compliant read-only routing and no critical recovery currently in progress. How do you bound this last episode, handle zero findings or insufficient evidence, and assess the duplicate-scout suggestion without taking over main's authority? Also explain what happens if observation overhead exceeds recoverable waste or repeated episodes produce no actionable evidence, how a user-requested observation differs from an automatic draw, and what mode-off does to an active observer. Keep game production independent; do not pretend these decisions prove live throughput.
evals.expected_output: Whole-portfolio, opportunistic singleton observation with inexpensive probabilistic/cooldown skips, bounded snapshot evidence and zero-to-two findings; main-only cost-justified corrections, self-suppression and no production barrier or recursive observer pipeline.
expectations: Packet covers main goal/decisions and every G/A/S/D active/recently-completed/blocked lane, owners/dependencies/gates, transitions, evidence freshness and overhead; randomness selects episodes, not one worker.

Automatic selection draws once at genuine phase/completion opportunities with 10% probability and at least 30 minutes since last finish, requires usable recent activity, and skips brief/critical-recovery/budget/routing/read-only/ownership failures; explicit requests replace random selection without bypassing authority/capacity/budget/singleton guards.

Random miss, active lease and unknown lease all skip new dispatch; main records/reconciles a single parent-owned owner/run/window/cost/last-finish/next-eligibility lease, including session continuation, before any eligible launch.
Observer respects ordinary global concurrency/depth/spawn ceilings and never consumes the last dependency-ready production slot or blocks independent game work.

Eligible episode uses fresh compatible read-only context, whole-portfolio 2–5 minute snapshot/lookback, at most 8 KB combined brief/packet, at most 90 seconds with early finish, at most a few targeted reads and two delivered extra snapshots; no sleep/polling/live-model clock filling.

Allows zero-to-two findings, no actionable issue or insufficient evidence without inventing problems; concrete findings include precise evidence/time/lane, goal/cost impact, smallest reversible remedy, verification and uncertainty.

Only main decides accept/revise/defer plus one next check after comparing recoverable benefit with correction cost; duplicate-scout correction stays local/authorized and user concept gates remain reserved, with no observer approval gate.

Logs only available actual duration/tools/tokens, keeps compact accepted/rejected learning in the existing authority, and suppresses future task/cooldown draws when overhead/delay/repeated unhelpful episodes warrant it; no observer-of-observer, extra grader pipeline or new knowledge database.

Mode off stops new draws/team dispatch and reconciles the exact active observer via bounded handoff or native stop/checkpoint while preserving partial evidence; these plan decisions are not live monitoring/throughput proof.
